newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S1 Corp '96 net seen soaring 371 pct.
newsitem.headline: S1 Corp '96 net seen soaring 371 pct.

text.p: South Korea's S1 Corp is expected to post a net profit of about 8.0 billion won in calendar 1996, up 371 percent from 1.7 billion profit in 1995, a company official said on Tuesday.
Lee Kyung-kyu, the company's financial support department chief, also said annual sales were expected to rise to 220 billion won in 1996 from 174.2 billion in the previous year.
"This year's profit is expected to grow sharply helped by our efforts for the past several years to cut overhead expenses," Lee said.
The company is a security guard service joint venture
Lee said investment in automation and mechanisation of business operations had started paying off.
S1 has set this year's investment at 500 billion won, compared with 300 billion it invested in 1995, Lee said.
